t: The Hilka Pro-Craft 160mm funnel is designed for efficient, fluid transfer. This 2-piece funnel features a durable plastic construction, making it ideal for mechanics, automotive technicians and DIYers working in workshops or garages. The large 160mm diameter and splash-resistant rim help minimise spills during pouring, whilst the removable mesh filter prevents debris from entering. A flexible spout measures 360mm in length to allow easy access to hard-to-reach reservoirs and engine bays.
b: Removable Mesh Filter to Block Debris
Flexible Spout for Reaching Tight Spaces
Delivers 360mm Reach for Deep Engine Bays
